job.title: Office Manager
job.description:
Looking for more than just another administration role? This is your chance to bring fresh ideas, improve processes and become a valued part of a great team!

We're currently partnering with an established construction business seeking an experienced and proactive Office Manager / Accounts Administrator to join their team on an initial temporary basis, with genuine potential to transition into a permanent position for the right person.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in their work and loves being the person who keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

The business has a welcoming, down-to-earth and inclusive team environment, and they're looking for someone who can bring not only strong administration and accounts experience, but also personality, initiative and fresh ideas!

The Opportunity
Working closely with the business management team, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day office administration and accounts function, supporting a busy and evolving construction business.

While there are existing systems and processes in place, there's a real opportunity for someone to come in, identify improvements, streamline workflows and help shape how the role operates moving forward.

This isn't a position where you'll simply be expected to follow the same processes every day. The business genuinely welcomes someone who can think for themselves, make suggestions and take initiative.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing day-to-day office administration and ensuring everything runs smoothly.
  • Accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice processing and creditor management.
  • Liaising with suppliers, contractors and internal stakeholders.
  • Supporting monthly invoicing and construction progress claims.
  • Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation using MYOB.
  • Assisting the management team with general administration and operational requirements.
  • Reviewing existing processes and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Helping streamline manual administration and accounting processes.
  • Taking ownership of tasks and proactively supporting the wider business.
About You
We're looking for someone who brings a great combination of accounts knowledge, administration experience and a genuinely positive, engaging personality.

You'll be someone who enjoys getting involved, building relationships and contributing ideas rather than simply waiting to be told what to do.

Ideally, you'll bring:
  • Previous experience in office management, accounts administration or a similar position.
  • Strong MYOB experience and confidence using accounting systems.
  • Experience managing accounts payable, accounts receivable and invoicing.
  • Excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive approach with the ability to identify improvements and take ownership.
  • Strong communication skills and a friendly, approachable personality.
  • The ability to work independently and manage changing priorities.
  • A reliable, professional and adaptable approach to work.
  • Experience within construction, trades or a similar operational environment would be highly regarded.
  • Exposure to progress claims or project-based invoicing would be advantageous.
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who's engaging, switched on and genuinely wants to make a difference.

Someone who isn't afraid to ask questions, share ideas and help improve how things are done. You'll enjoy being part of a team, take pride in your work and be comfortable wearing a few different hats throughout the day.

What's on Offer?
  • Temp-to-perm opportunity – genuine potential for a permanent position for the right person.
  • 3–4 days per week – a great opportunity for someone seeking part-time work.
  • Make the role your own – bring ideas to the table and help improve existing processes.
  • Welcoming and inclusive team – join a business where you'll be treated as a valued team member from day one.
  • Variety in your day – a broad role combining accounts, administration and operational support.
  • Supportive management – work with a team that values initiative, communication and a positive attitude.
  • Opportunity to contribute – play a genuine part in improving systems and helping the business operate more efficiently.
Interested?
If you're an experienced Office Manager or Accounts Administrator who loves getting involved, enjoys working with people and wants an opportunity where your ideas will genuinely be welcomed, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: People & Culture Manager
job.description:
An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced People & Culture Manager to join an established organisation in Melbourne's northern suburbs.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, enjoys building genuine relationships and wants to play an important role in shaping workplace culture, strengthening leadership capability and driving meaningful change.

We're looking for someone who brings a strong combination of strategic thinking, hands-on HR experience and emotional intelligence. Someone who can confidently partner with senior leaders, connect with employees at all levels and identify opportunities to make the business an even better place to work.

The Opportunity:
As the People & Culture Manager, you'll take ownership of the People & Culture function, working closely with senior leadership to support business objectives while creating a positive and engaging employee experience.

While the business has established HR processes in place, there's a real opportunity for the successful person to take a more proactive approach, introduce new ideas and help shape the future direction of the people function.

This is a role where relationships, communication and the ability to influence will be just as important as your technical HR knowledge.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Building strong, trusted relationships with senior leaders, managers and employees across the business.
  • Developing and delivering People & Culture initiatives that strengthen engagement, workplace culture and employee retention.
  • Partnering with leadership to identify opportunities for improvement and support business growth.
  • Coaching and guiding managers across leadership development, performance management and employee relations.
  • Leading proactive initiatives that improve the overall employee experience and strengthen the employee value proposition.
  • Supporting organisational change and ensuring employees understand the purpose and benefits of new initiatives.
  • Managing complex employee relations matters, workplace investigations, grievances and performance concerns.
  • Overseeing workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, talent development and succession planning.
  • Reviewing and improving HR policies, procedures, systems and processes.
  • Ensuring compliance with relevant employment legislation.
  • Using people insights, employee feedback and reporting to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
  • Supporting operational HR requirements while maintaining a strong focus on longer-term people strategy.
About You:
We're looking for an experienced People & Culture leader who genuinely enjoys working with people and understands the importance of building relationships before driving change.

Ideally, you'll bring:
  • A tertiary qualification in Human Resources or a related discipline.
  • Approximately eight years or more of generalist HR experience, including experience in leadership positions.
  • Strong knowledge of employee relations, industrial relations, performance management and employment legislation.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing business decisions.
  • A demonstrated ability to build relationships with employees across different functions, backgrounds and levels of seniority.
  • Experience developing or implementing employee engagement, culture, retention or organisational development initiatives.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to adapt your approach to different audiences.
  • Experience supporting organisational change and improving existing HR processes.
  • A proactive and commercially minded approach, with the confidence to identify opportunities and put ideas into action.
  • Experience supporting multi-site operations.
Most importantly, you'll be someone who is approachable, emotionally intelligent and genuinely interested in understanding people.

You'll know how to balance being a trusted advisor to senior leadership with being someone employees feel comfortable approaching. You'll also understand that great HR isn't just about policies and processes, but about creating an environment where people feel supported, engaged and valued.

What's on Offer?
  • A senior People & Culture leadership opportunity with genuine scope to influence.
  • Responsibility for the people function.
  • The opportunity to partner closely with senior leadership and contribute to business strategy.
  • A broad role combining strategic people initiatives with hands-on HR leadership.
  • The ability to introduce new ideas, strengthen culture and improve the employee experience.
  • An established organisation with a strong focus on its people and future development.
  • Melbourne's northern suburbs location.
Interested?
If you're an experienced People & Culture professional looking for an opportunity where you can genuinely make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Sarah Wilkinson at Morgan Consulting or apply directly through SEEK.

All applications and enquiries will be treated with the utmost confidentiality.

job.description:

Our Client is a specialist provider of water and pumping solutions, delivering quality products and services to a diverse range of clients. With a focus on technical expertise, reliability and customer satisfaction, the business is committed to providing effective solutions and ongoing support to its customers.

About the Role
They are seeking an experienced and motivated Service Technician to join their team. This is a hands-on role responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems and associated equipment across client sites and their facilities.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will play an important role in ensuring equipment operates safely, efficiently and reliably. The position will suit someone with strong mechanical and/or electrical aptitude, excellent fault-finding abilities and a genuine commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.

  • Install, commission, maintain and service a range of pump systems and associated equipment.
  • Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults and carry out repairs in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
  • Perform routine maintenance and preventative servicing to ensure equipment reliability.
  • Ensure all work is completed in accordance with relevant safety standards, environmental regulations and company procedures.
  • Liaise directly with customers to understand service requirements, provide technical advice and communicate job progress.

  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across service processes and operational activities.

  • A trade qualification in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Plumbing, Plant Mechanics or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Proven experience in pump servicing, maintenance or a similar mechanical/electrical service environment.
  • Experience servicing fire pumps and associated control systems will be highly regarded.
  • Strong mechanical and/or electrical fault-finding and troubleshooting capabilities.

If you are a technically minded Service Technician with strong mechanical and/or electrical capabilities and a passion for delivering quality customer service, we would welcome your application.

job.description:

This is an opportunity to join an established insurance specialist where you can utilise your technical expertise across a diverse portfolio of complex property, construction and contractual losses.

  • Interpret relevant policy wordings and contractual documentation when assessing coverage and exposure.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders while delivering high-quality technical outcomes.

  • Previous experience in Loss Adjusting, ideally specialising in construction, property or contract-related claims.
  • Strong understanding of construction practices, building methodologies, defects, damage assessment and rectification processes.
  • Experience reviewing and interpreting building contracts, construction agreements, variations and scopes of work.
  • Knowledge of construction costs, project delivery and contractual responsibilities.
  • Strong investigative, analytical and technical report-writing capabilities.
  • The ability to manage complex assignments independently and provide commercially sound recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach to resolving technically challenging claims.
What's in it for you?
This is an opportunity to join an established specialist where you can further develop your technical capability, work across interesting and complex assignments and build a long-term career in construction and property loss adjusting.
You can look forward to:
  • Competitive salary package, including a bonus opportunity of up to 40% depending on billables and base salary.
  • Company car allowance, negotiable depending on individual requirements.
  • Interesting and complex assignments across construction, property and contractual claims.
  • Career progression with opportunities to deepen your specialisation and take on greater responsibility.
  • Professional development to support your technical knowledge and industry qualifications.
  • Collaborative team culture where you can learn from experienced professionals and share knowledge.
  • Flexibility and work-life balance, with working arrangements to be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • Employee benefits and the opportunity to establish a long-term career within an established insurance specialist.

If you're looking for a role offering technical variety, professional growth and the opportunity to work on challenging construction and property assignments, this could be the right move for you.

What to do next
Apply now with your CV, or get in touch with Daniel Karmazin on 0452 223 681 or dkarmazin@morganconsulting.com.au for a confidential discussion to learn more about the role, the team and the opportunity.
Not actively looking? We'd still love to hear from experienced construction and property Loss Adjusters who are open to exploring their next career move.

job.description:

Our client is a customer-focused service organisation committed to delivering reliable, high-quality technical support and maintenance solutions. Their team prides itself on professionalism, safety, and efficiency, working closely with clients to ensure service outcomes consistently meet agreed standards. Due to continued growth, they are seeking an organised and proactive Service Coordinator to support our service operations.

As a Service Coordinator, you will play a critical role in the day-to-day coordination of service activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming service requests, scheduling and dispatching technicians, and acting as a key point of contact for customers. This role requires strong organisational skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced service environment.

  • Manage and prioritise incoming service requests
  • Schedule and assign jobs to technicians based on availability and skill set
  • Coordinate daily activities of service technicians and subcontractors

  • Communicate professionally with customers, providing timely updates
